reframe.title: Why fiber backfired (it wasn't your gut's fault)

reasons.title: Reason 1: the kind.
reasons.text: Many fiber gummies and "prebiotic" blends use inulin or chicory root. Your gut bacteria ferment it fast, and fast fermentation means gas.

reasons.title: Reason 2: the jump.
reasons.text: You went from almost no fiber to a full dose overnight. Any fiber change takes your gut a couple of weeks to adjust to. The label just said "take daily."

cards.result_label: Result: an easy trip to the bathroom

items.label: Fixes reason 1: the kind
items.title: Low-ferment fiber.
items.text: {FIBER_TYPE_CAP} {FERMENT_LINE}. No inulin, no chicory root, no sugar alcohols [[PLACEHOLDER: confirm against the final spec sheet]].

items.label: Fixes reason 2: the jump
items.title: The 7-day Slow Start.
items.text: Half a stick for the first 3 days, then a full stick. Printed on every box. Your gut adjusts before you hit the full dose.

honesty.text: **Real talk:** some people still notice a little extra gas in the first week. That's normal with any fiber change, and it's exactly why we ramp. If it lasts past week 2, drop back to half a stick and {EMAIL_US}. We'll help you sort it out.
